description: This file defines the Response class responsible for generating database backup SQL scripts for vtiger CRM. It extends the Target class and contains methods to initialize the backup, process table creation statements, backup table data, and finalize the backup with proper SQL commands and comments.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class responsible for generating SQL dump scripts for database backup, including table structure and data, tailored for vtigerCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Response object with database configuration and support for UTF8.

methods.name: startBackup
methods.description: Outputs the initial SQL statements and comments marking the start of the backup, setting up character sets and session variables.

methods.name: processTableCreateStatement
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating a specific table, including drop table, charset setup, and table creation SQL.

methods.name: startTableBackup
methods.description: Locks the specified table for writing and disables keys to optimize data insertion.

methods.name: processStatement
methods.description: Outputs an individual SQL statement, typically for inserting data into a table.

methods.name: finishTableBackup
methods.description: Re-enables keys and unlocks the table after data insertion is completed.

methods.name: finishBackup
methods.description: Outputs SQL statements to restore session variables and mark the end of the backup process.
